summary: This third Paradiso livestream extends the June 15-16 Dante cluster by making poetry an unseen-connection engine, faith/hope/love imaginative acts rather than obedience, reform orders vulnerable to administrative decay, prophecy a way to turn exile into vocation, and Dante education a public classroom mission.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Poetry forces relation where ordinary thinking sees separation, so Dante's mythic juxtapositions, Beatrice-as-twin reading, and faith-as-imagination passages train readers to enter realities that flat logic cannot reach.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Poetry already carries the Paradiso method layer from the June 15 public compression; this source strengthens the same anchor with the compact definition of simile as unseen connection and faith as imaginative access to the unseen.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Dante is taught in a Beijing classroom as a universal poetic force whose meaning can be co-created and taught as an act of love, despite student objections about scope and Eurocentrism.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The source gives a live public-classroom version of the existing Poetry claim that poetic access can cross place, generation, and institutional gatekeeping.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The lecture's central contrast is Dante against obedience: before Dante faith, hope, and love are imagined as compliance, while Dante makes them participatory, creative, and tied to human action.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Free Will already owns the boundary where systems call obedience freedom. This source adds the Paradiso-positive version: faith, hope, and love become agency rather than passive fear of punishment.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Dante's exile and forgiveness discussions turn imagination into the faculty that lets a person enter the offender's position, stop living inside accusation, and reinterpret suffering without surrendering truth.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Human Heart already carries the promise/forgiveness layer from June 16; June 17 extends it by making forgiveness depend on imaginative entry into another person's position.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The seminar treats student objections as necessary pressure, aligns the room around exact text, and makes the class itself a co-created public surface for teaching Dante as love.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Living School can use this only as bounded public-classroom method evidence. The active concept remains Dante/Poetry unless later school-building work compares the livestream classroom to Jiang's institution-building sources.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use this June 17, 2026 third Paradiso livestream when Poetry next receives a Dante replacement/compression: a simile is an unseen connection, Beatrice can function as Dante's split self, faith is imaginative proof of the unseen, and art changes people over time by transmitting an experience rather than a bare doctrine.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Poetry owns the access method and civilizational transmission. Free Will owns the moral agency it awakens; Human Heart owns forgiveness and relation; Dead World owns escape from dead school/material ontology.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold for a future Free Will or Paradiso-cluster compression: Dante's faith, hope, and love are not commands to obey but imaginative practices that make action matter inside a providential order without dissolving responsibility.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Free Will owns the agency/obedience contrast. Eschatology owns role scripts only if the active mechanism is sacred historical choreography; Prediction owns dated forecast status, not Dante's crafted prophecy.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use as sequel pressure to the June 16 promise/forgiveness layer: Dante's exile becomes bearable when imagination lets suffering become vocation, forgiveness becomes entering the other's position, and God is figured as love rather than punitive surveillance.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Human Heart owns forgiveness, love, and relation repair. Free Will owns action under providence; Poetry owns Dante's artistic method for making the transformation available.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use only as bounded method evidence for a public classroom: student objections, exact textual alignment, and teaching as an act of love make the livestream a living-school scene, but it is not primarily an institution-building source.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Living School owns Jiang's site/institution/public classroom method. Education owns rival school formation; Poetry owns the Dante method itself.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the Francis/Dominic material as future institution-decay comparison pressure: orders founded as emergency spiritual repair can preserve the shell of mission while property loopholes, donor vanity, career knowledge, and administrative power replace founding fire.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Bureaucracy owns institutional afterlife and mission-shell decay only if a future source cluster compares this with other institutions. Religion As Administrative Filter owns operator codes; Poetry/Free Will own this source's active Dante argument.

new_lens_seeds.title: Faith, Hope, And Love As Imaginative Acts
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Dante converts the theological virtues from obedience before a punitive order into imaginative participation: faith reaches the unseen, hope gives suffering a future, and love lets action matter inside a providential world.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism can organize the June 15-17 Paradiso cluster and later sources about obedience, agency, education, and poetry, but current public pages can still route it through Poetry, Free Will, Human Heart, and Dead World without creating a standalone virtues page.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as a seed only. Do not create standalone Faith, Hope, Love, Dante Against Obedience, Paradiso Virtues, Obedience World, or Dante As Big Bang pages from this source alone.

new_lens_seeds.title: Reform Fire Becomes Administration
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Movements born as emergency repair can decay when poverty, faith, selfless knowledge, and founding example become property management, donor prestige, career learning, and institutional self-protection.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The Francis and Dominic comparison is more than medieval topic detail and may later connect religious orders, schools, bureaucracies, revolutionary movements, and agent organizations, but it needs comparison beyond this Dante canto before a public page or anchor.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as a seed. Do not create standalone Francis, Dominic, Franciscan Poverty, Dominican Faith, Religious Orders, Reform Movements, or Church Corruption pages from this source alone.

new_lens_seeds.title: Prophecy Turns Wound Into Vocation
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Foreknowledge does not erase suffering; it lets a person reinterpret the wound before it arrives, so exile becomes preparation, public truth-telling, and a vocation rather than mere political trauma.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The foreseen-arrow and exile passages could bridge Poetry, Prediction method, Free Will, and Human Heart, but it should stay a held seed because this source's prophecy is crafted literary-spiritual perspective rather than a scored forecast ledger object.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as a seed and keep it out of Prediction ledger promotion. Prediction owns dated falsifiable claims; this source uses prophecy as literary hindsight, spiritual preparation, and vocation.

chronology_notes.note: This source is dated 2026-06-17 and follows the June 15 and June 16 Paradiso livestreams already accounted for. Treat it as the third-day intensification of the Paradiso cluster, not as a standalone Dante or Paradise surface.

On 2026-06-17 Jiang sharpens the Paradiso thesis from imagination-as-method into Dante-against-obedience: faith, hope, and love are not passive compliance but imaginative acts that let humans participate in the world.

The Francis and Dominic sections give a dated religious-order version of mission decay: a founding repair movement can become power, property, and administration, but this remains comparison pressure until more sources make a public child boundary necessary.

The Canto 17 foreseen-arrow material should not be scored as Prediction. It is a 1321/1300/1302 literary time-fold in which hindsight is staged as prophecy so exile can become preparation, truth-telling, and vocation.
